decision.limitation: Four alternating comparisons cover only eight exposed chronological edits with provisioned banks. A polarity-order control retains the same selector, but later paths may differ. Local guarded exclusions do not establish cheap general expansion.
decision.next_target: Test direct transport of surviving conditional unit certificates to the actual local cofactor under a fixed probe-selection path, starting from cnf_conditional_unit_support.materialize. Require local support containment, exact fixed/name maps and unchanged native checking; fallback on missing component support. Matching itself is small in the retained profile.
decision.prior_work: Broad normalization memos, prepared-cofactor memos, ordered normalization and canonical-header checking already exist, with mixed or negative costs. A new reuse proposal must identify an additional boundary rather than repeat these experiments.
decision.result: A live guard-guided probe selector reuses native canonicalization and retires expansion-owned coordinate hints. Exact tracking controls preserve original counters and SQLite files; all selected exclusions use existing checked local certificates.
decision.scope: Keep negative timings and unresolved roots. Automatic origin discovery, general coordinate transport, fresh unlabelled evaluation and unrestricted resource bounds remain open.

limitations: Incremental cumulative audit: every old six-table payload is byte-identical; new nodes and dependencies replay through both readers. Earlier complete-history and 342-partition checks remain hash-bound, not rerun.
Both readers fully check one database per target/arm. Four repetitions have identical six-table payloads, native counters, guard counters and binary archive hashes. All raw trials remain preserved.

Exact local native proof checks establish every published result independently of hint correctness. Coordinate hints are tested by unchanged-order controls, renamings, small exhaustive truth cases and native proof replay, not a Lean refinement proof.
All inputs are exposed and banks provisioned. Changed probe order can change search paths; a bounded local gain is not uniformly cheaper arbitrary SAT expansion.
All eight exposed origin/edit pairs are fixed before comparison, without outcome filtering. Source templates are provisioned; no fresh or population claim.
Four alternating serial repetitions per arm restore the exact causal prefix immediately after each origin. Later repeats, cumulative unions and posthoc census certificates never seed search.

Native is the preceding lazy solver. Tracking preserves its probe order with the new coordinate tracker and bank checks. Variable selects the first sorted eligible guard variable but probes False then True. Guided uses that same selector with the offered polarity first.
Variable is a polarity-order control, not a guarantee of identical complete search paths. Earlier probe publication and subsequent persisted reuse can affect later paths.

Actual local cofactors must pass the unchanged native lazy unit/binary probe before an exclusion is used. Hints never certify a parent; the opposite branch is visited and existing split/model lifting remains responsible for recomposition.

Template loading/copying is charged in setup; root normalization, certificate/support checks, matching, coordinate maintenance, native acquisition and publication are charged in solve. Source acquisition/extraction and final historical audits remain additional.

Complete-worker timing includes restoration, setup, retained-state accounting, warm replay of new native nodes, full native cold replay, result serialization and compression. Imports, frozen-source hashing and case loading are outside it.

Reuse native canonicalization and clean expansion-owned pending bindings on unwind. Guard-check and tracking-slot limits bound only those resources, not all verification, probe work, depth, copied banks or process memory.

Native checked-cache and template-bank bytes are retained-graph diagnostics. Process peak RSS includes preparation and cold replay; active tracking slots are not bytes. No uniform storage or polynomial SAT bound is claimed.
